name: Zenra-Taisen -BEAST PARADIGM-
source:
in a certain country, in a world inhabited only by kemono (male furries) The "Beast Penal Code" strictly forbids being naked at any time.

Ante, a male lion kemono, unexpectedly finds himself caught up in a battle to reclaim the original "naked" form of his kind! To unlock the "Pride Rock" (The Lock of Pride) that holds all kemono in subjection, you must destroy their dignity!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dakaisuke/male-furry-twinstick-shootingandnovelgame]Kickstarter[/url]]
